transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-authorization meeting on the extended library hours pilot. As I understand it, we're here to review the operating plan for the proposed eight-week pilot that would keep the main library open from 10:00 p.m. until midnight, Monday through Friday, with one library employee on duty and ordinary student-ID access. Before I can sign off on this plan, I need to hear from each of the reviewing offices — facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance — regarding any requirements or concerns you have. Let's go through them one at a time. Could we start with facilities?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious scheduling conflict. Facilities has a work order for a fire-alarm panel test in the main library every Wednesday evening during the proposed pilot period. The building cannot be occupied during that test. I received the work order this week but have not yet amended the library proposal to account for it. We'll need to address this — either by excluding Wednesdays from the extended hours or rescheduling the fire-alarm tests.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Before we move on, I need to raise a campus safety requirement. Our policy requires at least two authorized adults in the building whenever the library remains open after 10:00 p.m. I confirmed this with the evening patrol supervisor this week, but I have not yet added it to the operating plan. As the proposal currently stands, it lists only one library employee on duty, which would not meet this requirement. We'll need to amend the plan to include a second authorized adult during the extended hours.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a library IT requirement regarding the access-control system. During a recent system check, I identified a configuration issue: the system can support the pilot only if entry is limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards. If we allow unrestricted access for all standard ID holders after 10:00 p.m., expired and visitor credentials would remain active, which poses a security concern. I have not yet reported this to the director, but the operating plan will need to specify that access during the extended hours is restricted to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards.
